Thanks for the draft — nice layout. A few factual items and small redlines:

- For throughput, "2.5x" is internal peak on GPU cluster; can we rephrase to "~2–3x depending on batch/config" to be safe?
- We need to anonymize customer counts on page 3 (legal asks that we remove exact monthly active user figure).
- Please remove the mention of our internal micro-batching optimization (sensitive IP).

I've attached a quick redlined PDF (streampoint_redlines_v1.pdf) and highlighted the quote on page 2 — I think the sentiment is fine but prefer slightly different wording (I suggested an alternate sentence).

Also confirm: are you okay with logo use on the customer spotlights page? We'll need a short logo usage agreement (we can sign).

Happy to review a revised draft.

Best,
